approach: The root cause is already fixed in code: `reading::budget_reserve` (reading.rs:116) is the one reserve, and `Athena::preflight` (reading.rs:490) applies it at admission, dispatch, each planner and critic call, and the run stage. Before this change, the budget was checked per invocation after reading and planning had spent, against a reserve that left out the critic and later rounds. This change proves it at every spend and closes the two entry points I found that spend with prior spend and no reserve preflight. (1) `Athena::correct` (reading.rs:1324) reaches `read_for` at 1419, and `read_once` at 586 only checks the reader cap. (2) The dispatch re-read after a configuration change (run/mod.rs:1047, `reread_after_configuration_change` in run/pin.rs:149) does the same. Both get the existing `ReserveStage::Admission` preflight on the job's own spend. The duplicate retry preflight (reading.rs:1303) is removed, because `ask` → `first_reading` repeats it at 1203 and a test could not tell the two apart. Tests: one per entry point at one cent short and at exactly the reserve, a cap-varying table test over the six caps, a source-scan test for a second sum of caps, drain tests through `RealSteps`, and a CHANGELOG entry. Revision answers: findings 1 and 2 are answered in the criterion 6 demonstration, which now names its seam (the three configured checks as run by Athena's check stage, and the same cargo commands run directly) and what fails without the behavior. The other demonstrations are corrected as follows. The planner test targets round 2, because the round-1 planner reserve equals the dispatch reserve on the same spend. The critic test is made cent-exact with a per-call critic cost. The drain retry test is dropped and a config-change re-read test is used instead. No new refusal rule, config key, record or ReserveStage is added, so the share of past accepted readings newly refused is 0%.

decisions.choice: Close the two gaps by calling the existing `self.preflight(&jc, job.spent_usd(), ReserveStage::Admission)?` in `Athena::correct` (after the max_readings check at reading.rs:1344, before any record file is built) and in `dispatch` before the 'reading again' line (run/mod.rs:1046, so run/pin.rs stays out of the diff).
decisions.reason: A re-read runs the reader again and then the whole planning, producer and verifier path, which is the Admission reserve (`Config::budget_required`, config.rs:929). `first_reading` already judges `read_unread` on the job's own prior spend the same way (reading.rs:1201-1203). Reusing the stage keeps the sum of caps in `budget_reserve` only (criterion 2). The preflight runs before anything is committed, so a short job spends nothing and records nothing.

decisions.choice: Prove the planner, critic and run stages end to end through `Athena::go` (costs scripted so the spend is exact), plus one unit table that calls `Athena::preflight` directly for all seven `ReserveStage` forms and downcasts `BudgetShort`.
decisions.reason: Inside a run these stages turn the error into a recorded planning-stopped reason with the shortfall text (planning.rs:116-119 and 336-341, run/mod.rs:1367-1370), so `go` returns `Finished` with state Failed and not a `BudgetShort`. The end-to-end rows show the entry point calls the preflight (the later roles are not invoked, and the reason names the stage). The unit table shows the error type and the threshold. Together they cover both properties with no reserve logic in a test double.

rejected.why: By then the plan and any planner spend are committed, so it is not a hold before spend. The drain would hold and re-ask forever. Today it is a recorded failed job, which `round_one_critic_check_follows_the_shared_reserve` (run/tests.rs:2125) pins.

decisions.choice: The planner stage test targets round 2, and the critic stage test targets round 2 of 3. Round 1 of the planner is shown by the dispatch test and by the direct unit table only.

From round 2 on, the earlier critic's cost is in `closing.new_invocations`, which makes the planner preflight observable. Critic round 1 and the last round are already pinned cent-exact by run/tests.rs:2125-2194; the new test adds a later round.

rejected.why: It cannot fail when the round-1 planner preflight is removed, because dispatch stops the job first, so it would be a test that proves nothing.

decisions.choice: Put the cap-varying table test in run/tests.rs, calling `Athena::preflight` on an Athena from `athena_with`, with the expected coefficients written independently in the test.
decisions.reason: The refusal threshold is a property of `preflight`, which needs an Athena (run/tests.rs:191). A wrong reserve cannot hide when the test's own coefficients are literal. rejected.why: They have no Athena, so they cannot call `preflight` and cannot show the refusal threshold.

risks.risk: The cent-exact tests are float-sensitive (`reserve > left + 1e-9`, reading.rs:493).

risks.risk: The critic and planner rows depend on cost scripting of the fake driver, which enforces no cap. A cost above a role's cap may be treated differently by some path.
risks.mitigation: Existing tests already script a 31.24 planner cost against a 0.75 cap (run/tests.rs:2131-2146) and a 31.5 reader cost (2204-2208), so the pattern is proven. The new rows differ only in the critic's per-call list.

risks.risk: Round-1 planner removal is an equivalent mutant: the round-1 planner preflight equals the dispatch one on the same spend, so no end-to-end test can tell it apart.

(c) `preflight_dispatch`: reader cost 30.51 (left 19.49) → `go` returns BudgetShort and `Calls` holds only the reader; 30.50 → the planner runs. (d) `preflight_planner_round`: reader 0.01, planner 0.01, revising critique, critic cost list [31.99] → left at planner round 2 is 17.99 → stops with 'this planner call' and '$0.01 short' and one planner call; [31.98] → left 18.00 → the planner is called twice. (e) `preflight_critic_round`: R=3, reader 0.01, planner 16.00, critic costs [0.75] → left at the round-2 critic is 17.24 → stops with 'this critic call' and '$0.01 short' and one critic call; [0.74] → 17.25 → the critic is called twice. (f) `preflight_run_stage`: R=1, reader 0.01, planner 0.01, accepting critique, critic cost [34.99] → left 14.99 → planning stopped with '$0.01 short', no producer or verifier prompt; [34.98] → state Landed. (g) `preflight_resumed_unread_job`: R=3, a wrapper makes the first reader call return `structured = None` at cost 28.51 (the pattern of cli/tests/job_plan.rs:152-160), then `go` on the job (state Proposed with no reading, run/mod.rs:478-481 → `read_unread`) returns BudgetShort and the reader count stays 1; cost 28.50 → `go` returns Reread and the reader count is 2. (h) `preflight_correct` (new production check): job_usd 51.00, `ask` with reader cost 29.51, then `correct` → BudgetShort, and the records hold the same intervention, correction and invocation counts as before; cost 29.50 → Ok with one intervention. (i) `preflight_reread_after_config_change` (new production check): `ask` at job_usd 50.00 with reader cost 29.51, `commit_file` athena.toml with job_usd 51.00 (a reading input, config.rs:1296-1298), then `go` → BudgetShort, no 'reading again' line (recording UI), reader count 1, head unchanged; reader cost 29.50 → the reader runs again. (j) `preflight_every_stage_error_is_a_budget_short`: for each of the seven ReserveStage forms, `athena.preflight(&jc, spent, stage)` at left = reserve − 0.01 returns a `BudgetShort` whose `stage` equals the input and whose `shortfall()` is within 1e-9 of 0.01, and at left = reserve returns Ok. (k) Drain: criterion 5.
demonstrations.observes: Every held row returns or records a BudgetShort or a planning-stopped reason with '$0.01 short' before the next invocation, and every exact row succeeds. Cent-exact numbers come from literals, not from `budget_reserve`.
demonstrations.fails_without: Deleting the `preflight` in `first_reading` (reading.rs:1203) fails preflight_ask, preflight_retry and preflight_resumed_unread_job. Deleting run/mod.rs:1108 fails preflight_dispatch. Deleting planning.rs:116 fails preflight_planner_round. Deleting planning.rs:336 fails preflight_critic_round. Deleting run/mod.rs:1367 fails preflight_run_stage. Without the two new calls, `correct` and the dispatch re-read succeed, because the reader cap of 2.00 still fits in 21.49, so preflight_correct and preflight_reread_after_config_change fail. demonstrations.method: New table test in run/tests.rs. Start from `JobConfig::at` of the test repository with `[job_plan]` enabled (the Admission arm counts planning only when `enabled`, config.rs:930-933) and R=3. For each of six knobs (reader_usd, planner_usd, critic_usd, producer_usd, verifier_usd, max_rounds) and each stage (Admission, Dispatch planned, Dispatch unplanned, Planner rounds 1-3, Critic rounds 1-3, Run), raise the knob by 1.00 (max_rounds by 1) in a clone of `jc.config` and assert two things. (a) `budget_reserve` rises by a coefficient written in the test, not derived from the code: reader 1 at Admission only; producer and verifier 1 at every stage; planner and critic R at Admission and Dispatch(planned), R−r+1 each at Planner round r, planner R−r and critic R−r+1 at Critic round r, 0 at Dispatch(unplanned) and Run; max_rounds adds one planner-plus-critic pair at Admission, Dispatch(planned), Planner and Critic, and 0 at Dispatch(unplanned) and Run. (b) The refusal threshold moves by the same amount: with `job_usd = new reserve + spent` (spent 0.00 and 7.25, both exact in binary) `athena.preflight` is Ok, and with 0.01 less it is a `BudgetShort` whose `reserve` equals the new reserve and whose `stage` is the input. A second test, `planning_and_run_caps_move_by_exactly_the_cap` in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs, bumps each cap and asserts `planning_usd(n)`, `critic_usd()`, `run_usd()` and `budget_required()` move by exactly the bumped amount. The mutated-tree check is the mapping in criterion 3: the verifier deletes one `preflight` call (for example run/mod.rs:1108), runs `cargo test -p athena-core preflight_`, and sees the named test fail; the verifier may also read each test for the call it needs.
demonstrations.observes: All rows pass on the final tree. The reserve and the threshold both move by exactly the bumped cap at every stage.
demonstrations.fails_without: A reserve that left out the critic (the original defect) fails the critic_usd coefficient rows at every stage but Dispatch(unplanned) and Run. A reserve that left out later rounds fails the max_rounds rows and the planner_usd R−r+1 rows. A preflight that compared only the producer and verifier caps fails the threshold half (b) at every stage with planning terms. A preflight that ignores `spent` fails the 7.25 rows.

The config clone is the fixture; no double stands in for either function. Step 4 adds only the test; step 6 adds the config.rs unit test.

demonstrations.method: New tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs, using `Fixture::with_config(&with_job_usd(&test_config(), "17.00"))` (test_config has no [job_plan], common/mod.rs:37-69; reader 2.00, producer 10.00, verifier 5.00, so Admission is 17.00 and Dispatch is 15.00), `real_steps` (tests/drain.rs:4765), `RecordingLander` and `drain::drain` with `work_everything()` (tests/drain.rs:4792). The script is `Scenario::default().script()` wrapped, as in cli/tests/job_plan.rs:152-160, to set the reader cost by request text. (A) `budget_short_dispatch_leaves_the_item_queued_and_the_next_runs`: two queued items; the first item's reader costs 2.01, so after its read 14.99 is left and the dispatch is $0.01 short; the second item's reader costs 0.01. Assert `report.notes` has exactly one entry starting `item <id> is left queued:`, containing '$0.01 short' and '[budget] job_usd' and no newline; `report.jobs[0].outcome == "budget short"`; the producer role was not called for the first item; the first job is still queued in `Records`; the second item lands (`RecordingLander` holds only its id, `report.landed == 1`). (B) `budget_short_exactly_at_the_reserve_runs`: the first item's reader costs 2.00, so exactly 15.00 is left; it lands and no 'left queued' note appears. (C) `budget_short_reread_after_a_config_change_leaves_the_item_queued`: use `drain_after_config_change` (tests/drain.rs:3731) with the reader cost wrapped to 0.01 and `after = with_job_usd(&test_config(), "17.00")`; the first read leaves 16.99, under the new Admission reserve 17.00, so the drain holds the job with outcome `budget short` and one note, the reader count is 1, and no 'reading again' line is printed. The existing proof for the read side stays (cli/tests/job_plan.rs:143).
demonstrations.observes: The held item stays queued (still in state queued or proposed in `Records`, not failed), the outcome string is `budget short`, there is exactly one note, and the next affordable item reads, runs and lands.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the dispatch preflight (run/mod.rs:1108) lets item 1 run and land, so the note count is 0 and `landed` is 2 in test A. Removing the new re-read preflight lets test C re-read, accept the same-scope reading and land, so `report.landed` is 1 where 0 is expected. Removing the `Run.held` downcast at drain.rs:4701-4718 makes the outcome 'no outcome' or a failure instead of `budget short`. Removing the exact-case allowance (`reserve > left + 1e-9`, reading.rs:493) fails test B.

demonstrations.method: Run the three commands in this order on the final tree, each as its own command. They are the same checks Athena records: athena.toml:93-109 configures `[[capabilities.change.checks]]` fmt (`cargo fmt --all --check`), clippy (`cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`) and test (`cargo test --locked`). At verification `Athena::go_with_stages` runs them in the check stage (run/mod.rs:2037-2112, `routing::run_routed_with_record` through `SnapExec`) on the verification snapshot of the candidate tree, and each result is a `CheckRun` record. Before them, the producer runs `cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-data -p athena-cli` and reads every failure. The existing tests most likely to meet the new Admission check are those that call `correct`, the dispatch re-read or `retry` on a low job_usd (grep `job_usd` in run/tests.rs, run_pin_tests.rs, scope_guard.rs, cli/tests/drain.rs and lifecycle.rs:1704). The producer fixes only an affected test's budget number (as CHANGELOG.md:2197-2200 describes for earlier ones), never the reserve. It also runs `cargo test -p athena-core --test refusal_corpus`, which reads CHANGELOG.md (refusal_corpus.rs:1138, 1217, 1250, 1749, 2986, 3033, 3073, 3128, 3187); the new entry adds none of the negated phrases.
demonstrations.command:
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked
demonstrations.observes: All three exit 0 on the final tree: fmt prints nothing, clippy reports no warning, and cargo test reports no failed test, including the new `preflight_*`, table, scan, CHANGELOG and `budget_short_*` tests. The Athena check records for fmt, clippy and test on the final tree show `passed`.
demonstrations.fails_without: If any new behavior were missing, `cargo test --locked` exits non-zero: deleting the new Admission call in `correct` or before `reread_after_configuration_change` fails `preflight_correct` or `preflight_reread_after_config_change`; deleting any existing preflight fails the matching test in criterion 3; a second sum of caps added to core fails `no_second_sum_of_stage_caps_in_core`; a missing CHANGELOG entry fails `changelog_names_the_budget_reserve_fix`. A test helper added but left unused (`repo_with_job_usd`, `costing_each`) fails clippy with `-D warnings` (dead_code), and unformatted new test code fails `cargo fmt --all --check`.
demonstrations.seam: Production entry point: Athena's check stage (`Athena::go_with_stages` → run/mod.rs:2037-2112, `routing::run_routed_with_record`), which runs the three commands configured at athena.toml:93-109 and records `CheckRun`s (record built at run/mod.rs:2123 on the skip path; real runs through `SnapExec`).
